facts.text: John expresses that being a role model for young athletes is fulfilling and that his experiences help shape their future.

evidence.quote: It feels great to have their trust and admiration. Being a role model for these young athletes is so fulfilling. I'm glad my experiences can help shape their future and inspire them to go after their dreams.
Some of them do see me as a mentor, which is really rewarding. I try to provide them with advice and support on and off the court. Being a positive role model for them is something I enjoy.

facts.text: Tim took a photo of a sunset over a mountain range with a few trees last summer.

evidence.quote: I took this pic last summer. Seeing it was so stunning.
I snapped that pic on my trip to the Smoky Mountains last year. It was incredible seeing it in person.

facts.text: John appreciates the photo of the sunset over the mountain and acknowledges its beauty.

evidence.quote: Wow, stunning! And thanks. Really appreciate it. Means a lot.
Where did you capture this? Nature is truly amazing, isn't it?
